difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author's proposition at source lines 467-469: every finite Gamma has a tableau in which every branch is complete. The 13-line proof is a fair-saturation termination argument: take an open branch, enumerate the finitely many prefixed formulas to which a rule could apply, apply all applicable rules to each in a fixed order (propagating to branch tips after branching), then repeat on each resulting branch; termination and completeness follow from finiteness of prefixed formulas and used prefixes. The solver must reproduce the fairness discipline (no prefixed formula is left untreated) and the recursion over the branching tree; the argument is short but the termination reasoning must be stated exactly.
